name: zinput_di_get_joystick_ref_count
description: zInput::DI_GetJoystickRefCount returns the current joystick poll reference count.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x471dd0 clears eax, loads g_zInputJoystickPollRefCount into ax, and returns the zero-extended count.

Native smoke zinput_joystick_ref_and_enable_smoke verifies DI_GetJoystickRefCount returns zero before and after disabled AddJoystickRef, and observes the count through the enabled add/release workflow.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x471dd0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zInput joystick reference-count pass.
